answer: Sybil resistance works only when identity is expensive to fork. In our guild, a recruit joins by inheriting a vine of endorsements: three existing members each stake 50 credits and sign a public bond naming them. The recruit then completes a paid micro-task, graded blind by two members of another cluster, so nobody can approve their own clone. Each account is welded to one metered compute slot; a second identity means buying a second slot plus a walnut-sized deposit that unlocks after thirty days of clean work. Faked reviews slash the whole vine; that canyon of lost reputation is permanent.
